title: The Deep Debt
author: Yara Okonkwo
blurb: Paloma Brightwater, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
